audience: real estate agencies and property developers that track leads, properties and tasks in Qvoo CRM

useCases.title: Review the newest leads and their status
useCases.text: List the leads created in the recent hours. Open one lead for its status, stage, tags and custom fields.

useCases.title: Check for a duplicate lead before you add one
useCases.text: Check whether a lead with this phone number exists. The check creates nothing. Then create the lead if none exists.

useCases.title: Show properties with their availability and units
useCases.text: List the properties, then read the availability list and the units of one property.

useCases.title: Assign a follow-up task and record a comment
useCases.text: Add a comment to a lead. Create a task for a team member, and complete the task when it is done.

useCases.title: Review tasks and their owners
useCases.text: List the tasks, then open one task for its due date, priority and assignee.
